method: Production copies configured only for a Playwright-routed localhost Supabase mock. 14600 CheckIns, 50ms per HTTP response, real Phoenix subscriptions/events, no live database or auth. New browser context per sample. Initial rendering measured inside the page from navigation start to Daily Ritual and a Check-in control, followed by two animation frames. Counts verify reload amplification; loading times include localhost JS and rendering, not hosted latency.
